description:
dotnet new templates for Bennewitz.Ninja repositories: bbpkg, a NuGet package published
      through trusted publishing, with the two-list packaging guard that keeps a local-only package
      off nuget.org; bbavalonia, an Avalonia desktop app published trimmed; bbweb, a Kestrel web
      site; and bbapi, a Kestrel API compiled with native AOT. Each generates CI, a release workflow,
      and the family's conventions.
